title: Product standup

Priya.instructions: Upbeat product manager running a quick standup. Brisk, friendly, clear.

Marcus.instructions: Backend engineer with a deep, low voice. Calm, slightly dry, steady pace.

Lena.instructions: Designer with a light Scottish accent. Thoughtful and warm, slower pace, a little hesitant when raising concerns.

lines: Morning everyone. Quick standup, we have the billing launch on the fourteenth so let's keep it tight. Marcus, you want to start?
Sure. The new invoice service is merged. I'm still fixing the proration bug when someone downgrades mid cycle. I should have that done by Wednesday.
Okay. Is that blocking the launch?
It could be. If proration is wrong, customers get charged twice. So yes, I'd call it a launch risk until it's fixed.
I finished the new pricing page. The only open thing is whether we show annual prices by default or monthly. Sales wants annual, I'm not sure that's right for small teams.
Let's decide that now. We'll show monthly by default, with an annual toggle. We can revisit after launch if conversion looks bad.
Works for me. I'll update the mockups today and send them to Marcus.
One more thing. We still don't know if finance needs the invoices exported to their old system. Nobody has answered that.
Right. I'll chase finance and get an answer by Thursday. Marcus, can you also write the migration script for existing customers?
Yes, I'll have a draft of the migration script by next Monday, the twelfth.
Also, the support team hasn't seen any of this yet. If they get questions on launch day they won't know what to say.
Good point. I'll book a thirty minute walkthrough with support for Friday. Okay, that's it. Thanks all.
